svg.title: 369 contributions in the past year
svg.desc: Isometric 3D chart of dhruvag14's GitHub contributions between two seas. Each day is a tower whose height follows its contribution count. A giant lizard kaiju surfaces from the sea at random spots, flattens blocks of towers that later regrow, and shoots down helicopters with a blue-purple breath beam. Longest streak 11 days, 63 active days, best day 37 on 30 Oct.
